$meta.note: Design-token source of truth. Everything on-brand keys off this file. Generated CSS custom properties live in uipath-tokens.css.

roboticOrange.role: HERO color. Represents robots / RPA. Feature prominently; do not overuse.

deepBlue.role: Backdrop for brand-related content. Primary dark.

brightWhite.role: Neutral canvas, not an emphasis color. Also represents people (with black).

black.role: Backdrop for platform-specific content; represents people on light bg.

rules.hero: Robotic Orange is the hero; feature prominently but avoid overuse.
rules.semantic: Orange = robots/RPA, Teal = agents, White/Black = people, Deep Blue = brand content, Black = platform content, Testing Purple = testing only.

subheadline.licensing: PAID (Adobe Fonts / CC). Designers only. NOT freely webfont-embeddable — see webFallback.

backup.use: PowerPoint + fallback when brand fonts unavailable.

availability.poppins: Free — Google Fonts (embeddable in HTML compositions).
availability.inter: Free — Google Fonts (embeddable in HTML compositions).
availability.urbaneRounded: Paid — Adobe. Use free fallback stack in HTML video compositions unless a webfont license is confirmed.

webFallback.subheadline: Poppins Medium (until Urbane Rounded webfont license confirmed)

logo.clearSpace: = width of the 'U' in the logo

orange.use: All-orange lockup — reserved use per brand book. Best on white / light / neutral backgrounds.

whiteout.use: White logo for colored/dark backgrounds (e.g. on Deep Blue). NEEDED — preferred for dark video scenes.

black.use: Black logo for white/light backgrounds. NEEDED.

logo.wanted: SVG variants preferred over PNG for crisp scaling at video resolution and during zoom.

voice.note: Tone of voice is a core brand asset. Content director narration must match: human, direct, no jargon.
